chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from Fadalah, from 'Abd Allah ibn Sinan, from Abi 'Abd Allah عليه السلام, who said:
The salat of the two Eids is two rak'ahs, without adhan and without iqamah, and there is nothing before them nor after them.

key_terms.إِقَامَةٍ: the call announcing the commencement of prayer
key_terms.الْعِيدَيْنِ: the two Eid festivals, Eid al-Fitr and Eid al-Adha

ai.seo_question: How is the Eid prayer performed according to this hadith from al-Istibsar?
ai.summary: This hadith states the legal form of the Eid prayer: it consists of two rak'ahs and is performed without adhan or iqamah. It also indicates that there is no prayer prescribed before it or after it.
